title: Ivan Sells Cars
brand: built by I.Magin · draft for Ivan
headline: Ivan has been selling cars for years. Online, he doesn't exist.
subhead: This is that page, already built. Every blank on it is a question only Ivan can answer — and the whole thing goes live the same day he answers them.

sections.heading: The inventory
items: Hero — the lot, or the best car on it

sections.heading: What this page does for him
items: A used car is bought by someone sitting in a parking lot on their phone, deciding whether the seller is real. That decision takes about four seconds and it happens before anyone picks up a call.
Right now that search returns nothing, so the buyer scrolls to a dealership with a website and a photo of a building. The car was never the problem.

This page is the four seconds. A face, a lot, a number, and stock that looks photographed rather than snapped. Nothing here is a claim about Ivan's business — every figure above is his to give, and until he does it stays visibly empty.

items.name: This page, finished and live
items.note: One page, real photos, his phone number, found on his name in a search. Done in a day.

items.name: The full setup
items.note: Multi-page site with the inventory, a form that reaches his phone, and Google, Instagram and Facebook set up to match so the lot shows up on a map.

items.name: Kept current
items.note: Stock swapped as it sells, posts written and scheduled. Cancel any month, no contract.

sections.heading: Next step
sections.title: Ten answers and it's live.
sections.note: Stock count, years, financing, trade-ins, warranty, address, phone, and six photos. That is the entire brief. Nothing goes public under Ivan's name until Ivan says yes.

footer_notes: This is an unpublished draft made to show Ivan what his page would look like. It carries no claims about his business and is not live anywhere under his name.
